subject: Inference deployment fit + commit options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@edgewave.ai>, Nisha Gupta <nisha.gupta@edgewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T16:14:00-07:00
Subject: Inference deployment fit + commit options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Hi Tom / Nisha — great to meet you on the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment on sizing and pricing paths.

What we heard (summary):
- Primary use case: real-time product recommendations and short-form copy personalization behind API (user-facing, < 500ms desired p95).
- Expected steady-state usage: ~120M generated tokens / month (representative number from Nisha).
- Peak concurrency: ~150–200 qps during launches.
- Data residency: US only; a subset of data requires VPC/private control for compliance.
- Procurement timeline: aiming to finalize vendor and contract in May; pilot as soon as April/May.

Initial qualification questions we need to finalize pricing:
1) Can you share a representative prompt + response sample set (5–10 examples) so we can model token mix?
2) Confirm retention window and whether full KV caching is acceptable for session recall (you mentioned 30 days).
3) Who is the procurement/legal lead for contract + security questionnaire?

High-level economics (very rough sketches we discussed on the call):
- Hosted (per-token): good for variable traffic and fast time-to-value. Ballpark: ~0.60 USD per 1k tokens for gen+context in this workload => ~72k/month on 120M tokens.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): better for steady high-throughput (predictable unit cost). Example: monthly reserved pool (X GPUs) + overage pricing; break-even depends on sustained qps and utilization.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): for the regulated subset — includes one-time onboarding and higher fixed costs; combines reserved capacity with network isolation.

Attachments: I attached a draft MAP and SOW outline for your review (MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, SOW_outline.docx).

Next steps / proposed:
- Tom / Nisha: provide prompt samples + procurement contact this week.
- We (Redwood): prepare two-priced options (hosted per-token estimate + 12-month reserved capacity sketch) and a 4-week pilot plan.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short one-page comparison and an initial MAP by tomorrow.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-04-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inference deployment fit + commit options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Thanks Dylan — good summary. Real quick answers and a couple of clarifications: 

- Confirming the 120M tokens/month is our current internal forecast for the next 6–9 months (growth expected +20% q/q if launch goes well).
- Representative prompt: will send 6 examples (mix of short queries and 200–400 token responses) by EOD.
- Retention: default 30 days, but PII subset must not leave our VPC. We need a private/VPC option for that subset.
- Latency: we want p95 < 400ms for the majority of recommendation calls; longer is acceptable for non-interactive batch jobs.
- Procurement/legal: Priya Shah will be the procurement lead (priya.shah@edgewave.ai). Security review starts week of Apr 25.

On pricing: we’re interested in a direct comparison — hosted per-token vs a 12-month reserved capacity commitment. Can you include a simple break-even table (tokens/month vs reserved commit level) and a pilot option that lets us validate latency and reliability?

Appreciate the MAP — Tom

--
Tom Riley
Head of Product, EdgeWave
Tom.Riley@edgewave.ai | +1 510-555-0187

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: EdgeWave numbers + quick cost sketch

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding Tom’s confirmation. He asked for a break-even table and a pilot that validates p95 < 400ms. Quick internal sketch below to use for the MAP: 

Quick sketch (do not share externally yet):
- Assumptions: 120M gen tokens/mo, avg combined prompt+response = 275 tokens, peak 200 qps.
- Hosted per-token assumption: $0.60 / 1k tokens => monthly = 120,000k tokens * $0.0006 = $72,000/mo. (includes small margin for caching + streaming).
- Dedicated reserved example: 4x high-throughput instances (equivalent to N GPUs): estimated committed cost = $36k/mo for the pool + $10k/mo ops/support = $46k/mo. Overage pricing for additional tokens/throughput applies.
- Private VPC: one-time onboarding (~$25k) + monthly infra (reserved pool $46k/mo + networking and managed VPC fees $6k/mo).

Break-even: with these numbers, reserved capacity breaks even at roughly ~70M–80M tokens/month (given utilization assumptions). But we need to tune for their peak concurrency and latency SLOs; if they use lots of short prompts, dedicated will be even more favorable.

Ask: can we offer a customer-facing slide with 3 rows (hosted / reserved / private) and a break-even chart and recommended pilot sizing? I can draft the MAP and the pilot scope; would like your input on discounting and pilot terms.

Thanks,
Dylan

(added: please consider a 10–20% introductory committed discount and a 4-week pilot with token cap + SLA validation.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeWave numbers + quick cost sketch

Thanks — this is a good starting point. I’ll do the following:
- Draft a one-page MAP (attached draft MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) with milestones: pilot start, pilot evaluation, commercial commit decision.
- Add a pricing appendix with break-even table and two commitment tiers: 6-month and 12-month. Recommend offering 15% off reserved commit for 12-month.
- Prepare SOW outline (SOW_outline.docx) for a 4-week pilot (incl. telemetry/tracing, perf runbook, security handover steps).

Vivek — can you confirm the pilot sizing for a 4-week run (we should provision for 200 qps sustained during peak windows and enable prefix caching)? Also confirm what metrics we will measure: p95 latency, error rate, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens during the pilot.

Marissa
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Subject: MAP + pilot proposal (attached)

Tom — attaching the MAP draft and SOW outline we discussed (MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, SOW_outline.docx). High-level pilot plan in the attachment; highlights here: 
- Pilot length: 4 weeks (production-like traffic window for 2 of those weeks).
- Pilot sizing: reserve pool to validate p95 < 400ms at up to 200 qps; enable prefix/KV caching for session recall.
- Success criteria: p95 latency < 400ms for recommendation API, error rate < 0.5%, and a cost-impact readout comparing hosted vs reserved over the pilot window.
- Procurement/legal touchpoints: we’ll support security review and provide SOC2 evidence and network architecture diagrams for the private/VPC flow.

Next asks for EdgeWave:
1) Procurement contact (copied Priya if this is correct).
2) Representative prompt set (you mentioned sending 6 examples).
3) Confirm target pilot start date (we penciled Apr 25 for security intake).

If Priya is the right procurement contact I’ll loop in Legal and send a short procurement checklist.

Regards,
Dylan
